shared_elements: monumental anthropomorphic figure carved in the round
curved incised/relief lines on the body or face
justification: Both depict a monumental, heavily schematic human figure with an elongated blocky head and simplified anatomy rendered in low relief, which gives a broadly comparable overall impression. However, the actual depicted content differs: A shows the reverse of a torso covered with abstract motifs (rings, concentric circles, arcs, a crescent band) with no face visible, while B shows a frontal face with brows, eyes, nose, mouth and ears and no ornamental motifs at all.
